description: A precise stopwatch with start, pause, reset and lap recording. Shows minutes, seconds and centiseconds, with a list of every lap time you record.

faqs.a: It uses performance.now(), a high-resolution timer built into your browser, and updates about 32 times per second for smooth centisecond display.
Yes — because it is timestamp-based, the stopwatch keeps correct time while you switch tabs or minimize the browser. The display only refreshes when visible.
faqs.q: Does it keep working if I switch browser tabs?

faqs.a: Your laps stay on the page until you click Reset. They are not saved if you reload or leave the page.

howto: Click "Lap" while running to record the current lap time.
Click "Pause" to stop the clock without losing elapsed time.
Click "Reset" to clear the timer and all laps.
title: Stopwatch
